parts.name: Motor
parts.role: Drives the pump shaft through the coupling halves; CR units ship with heavy-duty 2-pole motors.

parts.name: Motor stool
parts.role: Standoff between pump head and motor; encloses the coupling and gives access to the shaft seal.

parts.name: Coupling guard
parts.role: Covers the rotating coupling halves for safety.

parts.name: Coupling guard screw
parts.role: Fastens the coupling guards (T20, 2 Nm).

parts.name: Coupling hex bolt
parts.role: Clamps the coupling halves together; torque depends on bolt size (13-62 Nm).

parts.name: Shaft pin
parts.role: Locates the coupling half and impeller stack on the shaft.

parts.name: Coupling half
parts.role: Transmits motor torque to the pump shaft; halves are a matched set, never interchanged between pumps.
parts.service_ref: CR-H service, Dismantling p. 2; coupling height pp. 18-19

parts.name: Pump shaft
parts.role: Carries the impellers and transmits coupling torque through the stage stack; must rotate freely by hand.
parts.service_ref: CR-H service, Reassembly p. 11; I&O §19 problems 1h, 4f

parts.name: Shaft lock nut
parts.role: Retains the impeller stack on the threaded shaft end (22 Nm).
parts.service_ref: CR-H service, Torque table p. 1; Reassembly p. 12

parts.name: Lock washer set
parts.role: Washer set locking the shaft nut; halves must stay paired as supplied.

parts.name: Splined (clamp) spacer
parts.role: Spacer clamping and positioning the stack on the shaft spline.
parts.service_ref: CR-H service, Dismantling p. 7; Reassembly p. 11

parts.name: Stage spacer
parts.role: Axial spacer setting stage positions within the chamber stack.

parts.name: Cartridge shaft seal
parts.role: Cartridge seal stopping pumped fluid leaking along the shaft; cannot be disassembled, replaced as a unit.
parts.service_ref: CR-H service, Dismantling p. 3; replacement criteria p. 10

parts.name: Inboard seal
parts.role: Inboard seal element used in tandem and back-to-back seal variants.

parts.name: Shaft seal securing screw
parts.role: 2.5 mm screws locking the seal collar to the shaft (2.5 Nm).
parts.service_ref: CR-H service, Dismantling p. 3; Torque table p. 1

parts.name: Pump head
parts.role: Top pressure casing (N models) carrying the head cover, seal, and discharge outlet.

parts.name: Pump head cover
parts.role: Cover closing the pump head; carries the shaft seal, stack compression springs, and Cool-Top disk plate.

parts.name: Cool-Top disk plate
parts.role: Cool-Top plate in the head cover carrying the guide bushing.

parts.name: Disk plate bushing
parts.role: Bushing guiding the shaft in the disk plate.

parts.name: Bushing retaining washer
parts.role: Washer retaining the bushings in the disk plate.

parts.name: Disk plate O-ring
parts.role: O-ring sealing the disk plate; replaced whenever the pump is disassembled.
parts.service_ref: CR-H service, Reassembly p. 13; replacement criteria p. 10

parts.name: Head cover plug
parts.role: Plug closing the seal-securing-screw access in the head cover.

parts.name: PTFE stack compression spring
parts.role: PTFE springs pressing the chamber stack together from the head cover.

parts.name: Outer sleeve
parts.role: Outer pressure casing enclosing the chamber stack between base and head.
parts.service_ref: CR-H service, Dismantling p. 8; Reassembly p. 12

parts.name: Sleeve flange
parts.role: Flange clamping the sleeve to the pump head with screws, washers, and nuts.

parts.name: Sleeve flange allen screw
parts.role: Allen screws fastening the sleeve flange (75 Nm).

parts.name: Sleeve flange washer
parts.role: Washers under the sleeve flange screws.

parts.name: Sleeve flange nut
parts.role: Nuts for the sleeve flange screws.

parts.name: Sleeve O-ring
parts.role: O-rings sealing the sleeve joints at head and flange; the hot-section ring always seats toward the stack.

parts.name: Suction/discharge base
parts.role: Bottom casing with suction inlet and discharge outlet; the cartridge assembly seats into it.

parts.name: Mounting base
parts.role: Bedplate the pump and motor mount on; the motor slides back on rails for seal and coupling service.

parts.name: Motor slide rail screw
parts.role: Rail screws connecting the motor to the base; loosened to slide the motor back.
parts.service_ref: CR-H service, Dismantling p. 2; Reassembly p. 17

parts.name: Motor bolt
parts.role: Bolts fastening the motor to the stool, tightened diagonally (13-23 Nm by size).
parts.service_ref: CR-H service, Torque table p. 1; Reassembly p. 17

parts.name: Base O-ring
parts.role: O-ring sealing the cartridge into the base groove.

parts.name: Cartridge support foot
parts.role: Support plate/foot slid over the staybolts under the cartridge.

parts.name: Staybolt
parts.role: Long through-bolts clamping base, sleeve, and head into one pressure casing.

parts.name: Staybolt nut
parts.role: 24 mm nuts tensioning the staybolts (CR-H 80 Nm, CRN-H 100 Nm).
parts.service_ref: CR-H service, Torque table p. 1; Dismantling p. 3

parts.name: Staybolt washer
parts.role: Washers under the staybolt nuts.

parts.name: Cartridge assembly
parts.role: Removable cartridge: stack, shaft, and seal handled as one service unit lifted from the base.

parts.name: Impeller (stage) stack
parts.role: Rotating assembly of shaft, impellers, and chambers; each stage adds head toward the rated total.
parts.service_ref: CR-H service, Dismantling p. 7; stage assembly pp. 20-24

parts.name: Top chamber
parts.role: Top chamber of the stack; anchors the stack straps.

parts.name: Stage chamber
parts.role: Stationary diffuser chamber of one stage, converting impeller velocity into pressure.
parts.service_ref: CR-H service, Dismantling p. 7; stage assembly pp. 20-24

parts.name: Chamber with bearing
parts.role: Stage chamber with an integral bearing supporting the shaft mid-stack.

parts.name: Suction inlet connector
parts.role: Two-piece connector feeding suction flow into the first stage.
parts.service_ref: CR-H service, Dismantling p. 7; Reassembly p. 12

parts.name: Neck (seal) ring
parts.role: Wear ring sealing the impeller eyelet against the chamber; inner edge faces the impeller.

parts.name: Seal ring retainer
parts.role: Retainer holding the neck ring in the chamber; has a relief slot for removal.

parts.name: Bearing ring
parts.role: Rotating ring running inside the chamber bearing.
parts.service_ref: CR-H service, Dismantling p. 8; Reassembly p. 11

parts.name: Stage impeller
parts.role: Rotating stage impeller adding head to the fluid; all stages sum to rated head.
parts.service_ref: CR-H service, Dismantling p. 7; stage assembly pp. 20-24

parts.name: Impeller wear ring
parts.role: Replaceable wear ring pressed onto the impeller (15/20 models); the wearing surface instead of the impeller.

parts.name: Chamber stack strap
parts.role: Straps binding the chamber stack for handling and assembly.

parts.name: Chamber stack strap bolt
parts.role: Bolt tensioning the stack strap (13 mm, 15 Nm).

parts.name: Chamber stack strap washer
parts.role: Washer under the stack strap bolt.

parts.name: Discharge flange
parts.role: Flange at the discharge outlet with a greased seal groove.

parts.name: Flange pipe plug
parts.role: 1/4 in. pipe plug in the discharge flange.

parts.name: Flange allen screw
parts.role: Allen screws seating the discharge flange diagonally (20 Nm) with no gaps.

parts.name: Flange ring
parts.role: Flange ring on the discharge adaptor, locked by the retaining ring.

parts.name: Flange retaining ring
parts.role: Ring locking the flange ring into its groove.

parts.name: Discharge O-ring
parts.role: O-ring sealing the discharge joint.

readout: Pos number + name + torque (Nm, CR-H values from the torque table)
